streams.title: New characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada is the only character currently being worked on. The wider plan lists more than 90 possible additions.
streams.activity: Adding physics to the pearl string on Nobuyuki's Day & Night Blades.
streams.description: The character expansion covers a large list of possible additions. Nobuyuki Sanada is the only character currently being worked on, and his import is still at an early stage. The overall estimate reflects the full character area, not just progress on Nobuyuki.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Nobuyuki is playable in testing with his Samurai Warriors 4 look, moves and physics, plus six weapons. For now he temporarily takes Kojirō's place.
substreams.activity: Adding physics to the pearl string on his Day & Night Blades.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki is based on Samurai Warriors 4. In the test build he can be picked from a Samurai Warriors 4 tab on Character Select and Duel, with his outfit and ponytail physics working. All six weapons are in: two from Samurai Warriors Chronicles 3, his Samurai Warriors 4 weapons, a sakura-themed Mythic weapon and a black and crimson X weapon. The lower blade now slides out only on the attacks that use it, as in Samurai Warriors 4. He currently borrows Kojirō's place in the roster, so Kojirō is missing until Nobuyuki moves to his own new character slot. His Gallery entry and a second outfit are not done yet.

streams.title: Costume additions
streams.summary: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits have been ported onto existing characters in a separate test copy. Sophitia's outfit is waiting on a braid fix.
streams.activity: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are working in a separate test copy; Sophitia's braid fix is paused.
streams.description: This area tracks outfit additions. For now, new outfits replace an existing outfit; extra outfit spaces are tracked under New character and costume slots. Planned outfits are not confirmed until work begins.

substreams.title: Sophitia outfits
substreams.summary: Sophitia's Broken Destiny outfit is built and her skirt physics work in game; her braid still falls to the ground in battle.
substreams.activity: The braid fix is paused until it is picked up again.
substreams.description: The Broken Destiny outfit has been built and tested in a separate test copy. The skirt swings correctly in battle. The braid hangs correctly in the Gallery but collapses in battle, and fixing it is the next step. Three Soulcalibur 2 outfits are also listed as lower-priority plans.

substreams.title: Samurai Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: 17 Samurai Warriors 4 outfits, with cloth physics, have been ported onto existing Samurai characters in a separate test copy.
substreams.activity: 17 Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are working in a separate test copy and have not yet been merged into the main build.
substreams.description: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are being brought back onto the same characters in this game, including cloth physics. 17 have been ported and checked in a separate test copy. They currently replace an existing outfit and have not yet been merged into the main Xtreme Legends build.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: Outfits from Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 are planned.
substreams.activity: Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 outfits are planned for several character groups.
substreams.description: The plan includes outfits for characters from the Wei, Wu, Shu, Jin and Other groups. Work has not started.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits
substreams.summary: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits are listed in the plan.
substreams.activity: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits remain under consideration.
substreams.description: This is a possible future addition and is not active work.

streams.title: New character and costume slots
streams.summary: A Samurai Warriors 4 character-select tab is working, and a first extra character slot has been tested. Extra outfit spaces are still being planned.
streams.activity: The Samurai Warriors 4 tab is in use; extra character slot work is paused until its next steps are scheduled.
streams.description: This area tracks plans for additional character and costume slots, and new character-select categories. It is separate from creating characters and outfits.

substreams.title: Character slots
substreams.summary: A first extra character slot has appeared and been picked in a test. It is switched off until its next steps are scheduled.
substreams.activity: Character-slot work is paused until its next steps are scheduled.
substreams.description: A first extra character slot has been added and could be picked in a test. A crash found during that test has been fixed. It is switched off until the test is repeated, its empty information panel is filled, and Nobuyuki moves into it, which also brings Kojirō back.

substreams.title: New character categories
substreams.summary: A Samurai Warriors 4 tab now appears on Character Select and Duel, holding Nobuyuki.
substreams.activity: The Samurai Warriors 4 tab is working on Character Select and Duel; the Gallery does not show it yet.
substreams.description: New character-select tabs have been added, starting with Samurai Warriors 4 for Nobuyuki and future characters. It works on Character Select and Duel. The Gallery does not show the new tab yet. Other proposed groups and their final names have not been confirmed.

substreams.title: Costume slots
substreams.summary: Additional costume slots are planned for future outfits.
substreams.activity: Additional costume slots are being planned.
substreams.description: This area tracks plans for additional costume slots. Costume additions are tracked separately.

streams.title: Improved graphics
streams.summary: Edge smoothing, light shafts and sharper shadows are working in game. A further update is prepared but not yet tested.
streams.activity: A further graphics update is prepared and waiting for in-game testing.
streams.description: The project uses its own graphics add-on. Edge smoothing, stronger light shafts, higher-resolution shadows and shadows from stage scenery are confirmed in game. A further update with sharper textures at an angle, less colour banding and quality presets is prepared but not yet tested in game.

streams.title: Menu improvements
streams.summary: Many menu layout and scaling fixes are in place, along with Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 button prompts. A broader review is pending.
streams.activity: Menu layout and scaling changes are awaiting review.
streams.description: Menu layouts have been rescaled across many screens, including a recent Gallery fix. Button prompt packs for Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 controllers have been added. Other menu changes are awaiting review.

streams.title: Larger battles
streams.summary: The limit on characters in a battle has been raised from 180 to 250 in testing, and distant soldiers no longer pop in at the edge of view.
streams.activity: Larger battles of up to 250 characters are ready for a full play test.
streams.description: The game normally keeps at most 180 characters in a battle, so distant soldiers vanish and reappear as others spawn. In testing the limit has been raised to 250, with a test battle reaching 241 characters without crashing. Characters are also now drawn further away. A full play test to judge the difference is still to come, and performance with larger crowds is being studied.

streams.activity: New and adapted stages are in the project plan.
streams.description: This area covers new stages and stages adapted from other games. The first selection has not been confirmed.

streams.title: New enemies
